title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer - Japan Government
description:
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.


The Role
 
Forward Deployed Software Engineers (FDSEs) work directly with customers to quickly understand their greatest problems and design and implement solutions to use data against them. Our customers rely on Palantir’s platforms for some of their most critical operations, and projects often start with an open ended question like “Why are we delaying so many flights?” or “How can we better identify instances of money laundering?” As an FDSE, you’ll apply your problem solving ability, creativity, and technical skills to help organizations use their data to drive a real impact in the world. You’ll have the opportunity to gain rare insight into and contribute to some of the world’s most important industries and institutions.
 
As an FDSE your responsibilities look similar to those of a startup CTO: you’ll work in small teams with minimal supervision and own end-to-end execution of high stakes projects. Your day might span discussing architecture with fellow engineers, wrangling massive-scale data, coding a custom web app, speaking with customer executives, or establishing strategy for your team.
 
Whether you aspire to be an entrepreneur or an engineering leader, we believe Palantir is the best place — with the best colleagues — to learn how. You’ll learn how to unpack a problem and understand the costs and consequences of its solution. You’ll learn new technologies and languages, and even develop them yourself. You’ll work autonomously and make decisions independently, within a community that will support and challenge you as you grow and develop.

Our Principles
Impact: We take on meaningful and challenging projects that change the world for the better
 Ownership: We see projects through from beginning to end, working through any obstacles we may encounter
 Collaboration: We work internally with people from a variety of backgrounds — such as other FDSEs, product teams, and Deployment Strategists. We also work externally with our customers, often on-site, to understand and solve their problems.
 Trust: We trust each other to effectively manage time and priorities and give people the space to think for themselves
 Growth: We encourage ourselves and our peers to seek new challenges and opportunities for growth, as well as find new ways to innovate and share knowledge
 Learning: We often face entirely novel problems where we need to pick up a lot of new knowledge and learn how to use it to make progress. We believe experiential learning is one of the best teachers.
What We Value
A highly analytical mindset and eagerness to solve technical problems with data structures, storage systems, cloud infrastructure, front-end frameworks, and other technical tools
 Experience or interest in working with and using large scale data to solve valuable business problems
 Strong coder with demonstrated proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, C++, TypeScript/JavaScript, or similar
 Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively in teams of technical and non-technical individuals, and comfortable working in a rapidly changing environment with dynamic objectives and iteration with users
 Ability to continuously learn, work independently, and make decisions with minimal supervision
Requirements
Applicants must be proficient in both English and Japanese languages.
 Security clearance or the ability to obtain clearance
 1+ years of relevant, post-college work experience
 Strong engineering background, preferred in fields such as Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Physics, and Data Science
 Willingness and interest to travel as needed to client sites. Ability to travel 25 – 75% required. Varies by location and team.

title: R&D Propulsion System Engineer
description:
ispace, inc. is looking for highly motivated Propulsion System Engineer advanced research & development (ARD) group.
 
This position is based in Tokyo, Japan and will require you to relocate. This is not a full remote position.
 
Successful candidate will  participate in two types of ARD projects: 
 
1) new technology development/demonstration and 
2) next generation lunar transportation, infrastructure, and resource utilization system architecture creation from initial concept to system preliminary design level. 
 
This role focuses on high thrust propulsion systems, including earth-storable propulsion and advanced propulsion concepts. You will work within a multidisciplinary, model‑driven design team, developing Python‑based propulsion models, exploring large tradespaces, leading technology demonstration projects, and shaping the propulsion architecture of future ispace vehicles.
 
It is expected that technical solution concepts start at mid/low technical maturity and you develop them to a CML2+ level (see JPL "concept maturity level" scale).
 
#LI-Hybrid

Key responsibilities 
Lead propulsion architecture definition and modeling for conceptual‑level system studies of different elements of lunar transportation missions (e.g., Orbit Transfer Vehicles, landers, orbital infrastructure), following ARD guidance and contributing through the concept maturation.
 Develop and maintain Python‑based propulsion models for sizing and system‑level tradespace analysis.
 Assess, compare, and select main‑engine propulsion options - including pressurization, propellant management, feed systems, engine cycles, and key component selections - to optimize system KPIs.
 Investigate and evaluate cutting‑edge propulsion technologies, generating recommendations for future R&D activities and long‑term capability roadmaps.
 Support R&D implementation projects, including propulsion‑related technology demonstrations and customer‑driven development efforts from concept to testing campaign.
 Contribute technically to early‑phase business development, collaborating with Business Development and Government Relations teams to inform proposals and strategic studies.
 Work closely with multidisciplinary ARD members (structures, comms, thermal, GNC, mission design) to ensure propulsion concepts integrate coherently with system‑level architecture.
Basic Qualifications
Bsc. or Masters degree / experience in mechanical, aerospace, or related engineering fields.
 Five or more years of relevant experience in analytical modelling of chemical propulsion, including pressurization system, feeding system, boil-off, propellant transfer, propellant management devices, rocket engine cycle, mass and fluid budget analyses.
 Solid understanding of mission‑level propulsion considerations (e.g., delta‑V budgeting, propellant selections, pressurization and feedsystem architectures, usable and unusable propellants, sloshing, and mission environments).
 3 years of experience with relevant modelling programming languages (Python: NumPy, SciPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, or alternatively strong experience in matlab).
 Ability to work in fast‑paced, ambiguous conceptual environments and take proactive technical ownership.
Preferred qualifications 
Experience in propulsion system components selection, trading-off technical compatibility, schedule, and cost
 Experience with advanced propulsion architectures such as cryogenic and hybrid rocket propulsion systems.
 Experience as systems engineering applying the Model Based Systems Engineering approach
 Experience with conceptual design methods, low‑fidelity modeling, or early‑phase systems engineering.
 Eperience using Git for version control in a CI/CD environment, contributing to shared codebases, reviewing merge requests, and maintaining high‑quality, reproducible model development practices.

title: Staff Software Engineer (TLM), Field Response
description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.
 The Field Response Team protects Waymo's operations by detecting, mitigating, and preventing real-world autonomous driving issues before they have a significant impact. The team is involved across the entire issue-identification and resolution lifecycle. As we expand our operations to Tokyo, we are building out local expertise to navigate region-specific driving environments and support our global 24/7 deployment cycle.
 You will: 
 Develop systems to detect issues in the field not only specific to the Japanese driving environment but across all of Waymo’s international markets.
 Hire, mentor, and lead a small team of software engineers, fostering a culture of high ownership, technical excellence, and rapid execution.
 Build systems and tools to help monitor the fleet as Waymo continues to scale including new software roll outs, new geos and new platforms.
 Partner closely with Data Science, Onboard Software, Mapping, and other engineering teams to identify system bottlenecks and design end-to-end technical solutions.
 Lead strategic investments to improve the quality of existing diagnostic signals, ensuring they scale seamlessly across all of Waymo's geographies and Operational Design Domains (ODDs).
 You have: 
 BS or MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field of study.
 5-7+ years of hands-on software development experience building highly scalable, reliable, and performant systems.
 1-2+ years of experience directly managing and mentoring software engineering teams.
 Strong system design capabilities and fluent coding skills in C++, Python, and SQL.
 Proven ability to tackle highly open-ended technical and system design challenges with a structured, first-principles approach.
 Growth mindset, eagerness to learn, and a genuine excitement for the future of autonomous driving.
 Professional or native-level fluency in both Japanese and English to seamlessly bridge communication across international markets.
 We prefer: 
 Deep familiarity with driving dynamics, local infrastructure, and road environments in Japan (specifically Tokyo), with an intuitive understanding of local traffic etiquette and pedestrian behavior.
 Prior experience in mapping, localization, geospatial engineering, or high-volume data pipelines within the autonomous vehicle, robotics, or geographic information systems (GIS) industries

title: Systems & Network Engineer, Japan
description:
Systems & Network Engineer 
Are you a Systems & Network Engineer with a passion for designing, implementing, and maintaining robust infrastructure solutions? If so, CIC invites you to join our dynamic team as a Systems & Network Engineer. As a key member of our technology department, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the reliability, security, and efficiency of our systems and network architecture.
 
ABOUT CIC
CIC builds and operates spaces where startups, scale-ups, corporations, and public institutions come together to overcome challenges and grow.Founded in 1999, CIC was one of the first companies to offer flexible office space and coworking options, providing a platform for entrepreneurs to develop their ideas in a shared environment.
CIC manages a global network of workspaces, laboratories, and event spaces across North America, Europe, and Asia. Beyond our spaces, CIC also develops innovation-focused programming, builds and enables industry clusters, and offers consulting services to help the public and private sectors foster innovation ecosystems. 
We invite you to explore our opportunities and learn more about our teams here.
 
YOUR DAY-TO-DAY WORK
 As a Systems & Network Engineer at CIC, you will be responsible for ensuring the reliability, security, and scalability of our systems and network infrastructure. You will play a critical role in the design, implementation, and maintenance of our systems to support our current and future business requirements.
Key Responsibilities:

Networks: Monitor, troubleshoot, configure our networks (we are very heavy on Wi-Fi, which is one of the main services provided to our clients) with hundreds of Access Points and low footprint network stacks (Extreme / Ruckus)
Physical Access Control: Set up and manage scalable and reliable door access controls for CIC’s Campuses across the world. This means thousands of locks globally, even more user access cards which must give and take access to our spaces securely and reliably. 
Deploy and Maintain: Introduce and operate core and auxiliary systems, including but not limited to cloud services (Google Workspace / GCP / Atlassian JIRA SM / ElasticSearch) and internal tools running on docker / kubernetes and both Windows and Linux VMs 
Capacity Planning: Monitor network traffic and systems usage patterns, and proactively plan for capacity expansion to meet growing demands.
Vendor Management: Collaborate with vendors and suppliers to procure and maintain network hardware, software, and services at quality level.
Documentation: Maintain comprehensive network and systems documentation, including network diagrams, configurations, and change management records.
Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams to understand their requirements and provide technical guidance and support.
Emergency Response: Participate in on-call rota for network-related emergencies and provide timely resolution and support.

ABOUT YOU
Highly skilled and experienced professional who possesses a combination of technical expertise, independency, and a commitment to ensuring the integrity and performance of systems and network infrastructure. Here are the key characteristics and qualifications of the ideal candidate: 
Demonstrates a deep understanding of network protocols, technologies, and best practices. You know what ANonce and SNonce are and network attenuation is no stranger to you.
Exceptional problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to diagnose complex IT issues and implement effective solutions.
Proven ability to design and implement IT solutions to meet the organization's requirements, ensuring high availability and scalability.
Possesses excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, for conveying complex technical information to non-technical stakeholders.
Is prepared to be on-call for network-related emergencies and can provide timely resolution and support.
Works effectively within cross-functional teams, collaborates well, and demonstrates a commitment to teamwork and shared goals.
Able to work independently as an individual contributor to align expectations with local and global colleagues.
YOU HAVE
 
Proven experience as a systems / network engineer, with at least 7 years as Network System Engineer 
 
•Experience working with IT Service Management principles
•Working knowledge of eXtreme Networks, Ruckus or other network equipment (Cisco and Juniper are fine!)
•Experience with physical access controls would be an advantage
•Familiarity with network security principles and best practices (Zero Trust / SASE)
•Knowledge of monitoring tools like Nagios, Zabbix or similar.
•Experience with one of the leading Cloud IaaS / PaaS providers (GCP, AWS or Azure). 
•Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
•Strong communication and collaboration abilities. 
•Advanced or native level Japanese and business level or above English.
 
Nice to Have
•Experience of working with globally distributed team
•ITIL certification
 
OUR OFFER
• Competitive salary, commensurate with experience.
• 6-month contractor engagement, with transition to a permanent contract.
• Commuting / Transportation allowance.
• Massage session once a month.
• Allocated budget for training (customized to specific requirements of the role and organization's objectives)
• Retirement allowance after successfully passing the probation period.
 
 Please submit your application in English. Thank you! 
CIC welcomes all candidates regardless of race, color, ancestry, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status or disability. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.
Measures against passive smoking: No smoking indoors allowed. Smoking is not permitted outside of designated areas.

title: Ground Systems Engineer (Developer)
description:
ispace is looking for Ground Systems Engineer to join our growing team in Tokyo. 
 
The Ground Systems team forms the backbone of ispace’s Test and Flight Operations, delivering the infrastructure, systems, and tools required to support mission testing and operational activities across the full mission lifecycle. This includes the design, development, and maintenance of the Mission Control Center, Mission Control Software, operational toolchains, and end-to-end test environments that ensure mission readiness.
As a Ground Systems Engineer, you will be responsible for the design, development, and maintenance of Mission Control Software supporting ispace’s global operations. You will oversee the end-to-end data flow between users and the spacecraft, ensuring reliable, secure, and efficient handling of telemetry and telecommand data. This includes defining and implementing data encoding, processing, and encryption mechanisms across the ground segment and its interfaces.
 
Type: Full-time Position
Location: Hybrid (Tokyo, Japan) On site at least twice a week with remote option
Experience Level: See Qualifications below
Group: JP Ground Systems Group, JP Test and Flight Operations Division

Why this role matters? 
As a Ground Systems Engineer, your work directly enables communication with the spacecraft and underpins every phase of mission test and execution. You play a pivotal role in ensuring that missions are conducted safely, reliably, and efficiently—designing and maintaining the infrastructure, software, and operational workflows that make real-time spacecraft operations possible. Your contributions not only ensure mission success, but also streamline operations and empower flight teams to perform at their best.
Key responsibilities 
Ground Segment Design, Infrastructure and Development 
 Collaborate with customers and internal stakeholders (System and Subsystem Engineers,AIT, Mission Operations, etc.) to gather requirements, and design, develop, document,procure, maintain, and deploy ground segment systems.
 Design, develop, and maintain cloud-native ground segment software applications andmicroservices, including mission control systems, automation tools, and data pipelines.
 Design, deploy, and maintain cloud infrastructure on AWS, including containerisedenvironments using Docker and Kubernetes, ensuring reliability, scalability, and security ofground segment services.
 Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitLab, Ansible) for continuous delivery of groundsegment software components.
 System Integration & Testing 
 Oversee the integration of software components within the virtual infrastructure hosting theground segment, ensuring proper interfacing with spacecraft systems and external groundelements (e.g., EGSE, PIL components).
 Develop and execute test plans, procedures, and configurations, including end-to-end validation of communication and control links.
 Support V&V activities across the ground segment.
 Operations Support 
 Develop, test, and validate operational procedures.
 Participate in training activities and mission rehearsals to achieve certification for on-consoleoperations.
 Own and maintain Ground-to-Ground Interface Control Documents (ICDs), and contribute to Space-to-Ground ICDs with ground station providers.
 Support on-console operations, including 24/7 shift work and on-call duties during criticalmission phases.
Required skills 
Language: Professional level English (written and verbal); Japanese is a plus.
 Experience: 3+ years of experience in ground systems engineering or software development for space missions (LEO, MEO, Deep Space, etc.).
 Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with AWS and container orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes.
 Software Skills: Proficiency using Python and Bash; strong expertise in CI/CD tools such as Ansible, Gitlab.
 Operating systems: Solid knowledge of Linux; familiarity with Windows environments.
 Self-driven: Be organized and capable of planning and executing complex technical work with little oversight. Be driven, continuously self-improving, and proud of her/his work.
Preferred skills 
Experience with mission control systems (e.g., Yamcs, Grafana).
 Familiarity with CCSDS protocols, telemetry processing, and commanding chains.
 Full-stack engineering experience developing high-availability tools in a productionenvironment.
 Experience with relational and non-relational databases (SQL, MongoDb, Influx, etc.)
 Familiar with network protocols and tools.
 Experience in the space industry.

title: Senior Flight Software Systems Engineer
description:
ispace is seeking a highly motivated and talented Senior Flight Software Systems Engineer to join the System Design Group under the Global Design division, responsible for the design and development of lunar landers and other transportation and/or communication/navigation platforms.
The ideal candidate will have in-depth experience on embedded flight software design, implementation, integration, V&V and operations on highly-autonomous space systems, solid understanding of design drivers for FDIR, mode management and on-board executed procedures, good technical knowledge of multiple spacecraft subsystems and experience in the system engineering disciplines for spacecraft design.
This is a unique opportunity to join a truly fascinating project, the first stage of ispace’s plans to perform resource prospecting on the moon. In this position, you will be assigned to one or more of ispace's projects, and join a small, international team of engineers working towards the detailed design and qualification of our first missions.
Candidates with demonstrated "hands-on" experience in some engineering domains and interdisciplinary experience are preferred. Teamwork is valued, and depending on the strengths of each member of the systems engineering team, the responsibilities listed below will be assigned accordingly.

Key responsibilities
Support the definition of a “product baseline”, creating standard requirements, system architecture, ICDs, design and analysis goals, test plans and operations concepts.
 Lead and perform safety analyses including Fault Tree Analysis (FTA), Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA/FMECA), and related methods.
 Perform system level trade-offs, coordinating inputs from various disciplines within the team, to evaluate any proposed changes of the design baseline to satisfy the need of each individual mission.
 Ensure internal interfaces between various spacecraft subsystems are maintained.
 Contribute to requirements management ensuring all requirements are closed-out at the planned project landmarks.
 Support AIT/Flight&Test Operations Groups and subsystem leads in defining test plans and specifications which will successfully verify the spacecraft design.
 Coordinate efforts between relevant subsystems and Operations Team in defining a spacecraft operational concept.
 Contribute to the maintenance of our Model-Based Systems Engineering tools and the integration.
Required skills 
Bachelor or Masters degree in Computer Science, Mechanical, Electrical, Aerospace Engineering or equivalent
 5+ years of experience in design, implementation, integration, and V&V of embedded flight software subsystem
 Operational experience, including preparation of operations, participation in rehearsals and on-console activities.
 Experience performing FMECA, reliability analysis, and/or hazard analysis
 Experience with programming languages such as Matlab, Python, or equivalent
 Self-motivated and comfortable making key decisions within a fast-paced environment
 High sense of accountability and ownership
 Excellent presentation skills, both verbally and written. Enthusiastic attitude and team player
 Working level in English
Preferred skills 
Experience with design, analysis or testing of at least one other subsystem: Structure, Thermal, Avionics, Propulsion, Communications, GNC.
 Experience with requirement decomposition (mission all the way to unit level)
 Experience with system level testing such as hardware-in-the-loop testing
 Working level Japanese

title: Senior OGNC/AOCS System Engineer
description:
ispace is looking for a Senior Orbital Guidance, Navigation, and Control System Engineer to join our growing team in Tokyo. 
 
You will lead the end-to-end development of the lunar lander’s orbiter system—including design, verification, and operations—from the perspective of the Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GNC) subsystem. Define and manage requirements for the GNC subsystem, including sensors, software and other hardware components. Manage technical coordination and interface alignment with other subsystems. Manage the integrity and performance of GNC algorithms in the FSW development and deliverables. Support mission operations and preparation activities.
 
月着陸船の軌道系誘導航法制御サブシステムの観点から、軌道系GNCサブシステム全体開発（設計、検証、運用）を担当する。センサー、ソフトウェアおよびその他のハードウェアコンポーネントを含む軌道系誘導航法制御サブシステムの要求定義、管理を行う。各サブシステムとの技術調整、インターフェース調整を担当する。FSW開発および成果物におけるGNCアルゴリズムの完全性と性能を管理する。ミッション運用および準備活動を支援する。

Key responsibilities 
(1) Join our engineering team overseeing the entire lunar lander orbiter system, supporting end-to-end development—design, verification, and operations—from the perspective of the Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GNC) subsystem.
(2) Develop orbiter GNC design and perform GNC-related analysis (such as guidance law design and analysis, control law design and performance analysis, thruster duty analysis, DV analysis, attitude dynamics analysis, sloshing and flexible dynamics, navigation filter design, covariance analysis, various GNC sensor evaluation, etc) by using control engineering tools as well as software development activities.
(3) Design the system and the orbiter Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GNC) subsystem using FMECA (Failure Mode, Effects, and Criticality Analysis) and MCFMA (Mission Critical Fault and Mitigation Analysis) methodologies.
(4) Plan, implement, and execute comprehensive verification and validation activities for the orbiter system, spanning from component-level (GNC sensors) to system-level tests (SCLT, DOLT, DCLT). These include nominal, off-nominal, and fault simulations for orbit operations.
(5) Define OGNC flight software/algorithm requirement specifications
(6) Develop GNC subsystem requirements, design, constraints, and operations with a deep understanding of the technical coordinations and interface alignments with systems engineering and other subsystems (propulsion, structures, thermal, avionics, flight software, mission planning, and operations).
(7) Define OGNC unit specifications as flow-down of the OGNC system requirements and design specifications
(8) Support lander system design with providing GNC feasibility studies and design inputs for the key system design trade-offs such as actuator and sensor configuration and selection, component layout, controlability, delta V, RCS budget, etc.
(9) Support the selection, verification, and operational readiness of key orbiter system components—such as Sun sensors, IMUs, star trackers and propulsion—from both technical and theoretical perspectives.
(10) Design and support throubleshooting activities of GNC FSW algorithms and components and propose solutions to mitigate errors and misbehaviors in the GNC subsystem.
(11) Document the technical specifications of the GNC subsystem with a deep understanding of the functions and relations with other subsystems. 
 (1) 月着陸船のシステム全体を統括するエンジニアリングチームの一員として、主に誘導航法制御サブシステムの観点から、軌道系GNCサブシステム全体開発（設計、検証、運用）をサポートする。
(2) 軌道系誘導航法制御に関する設計解析（誘導制御則設計、制御性能解析、スラスタ制御解析、DV解析、姿勢力学解析、スロッシング、柔軟ダイナミクス解析、航法フィルタ設計、誤差共分散解析、GNCセンサ評価など）を制御工学ツールとソフトウェア開発活動を通して実施する。
(3) FMECA（Faulure Mode, Effects, and Criticality Analysis）およびMCFMA（Mission Critical Fault and Mitigation Analysis）に基づくシステムおよび軌道系GNCサブシステムのロバストな設計を行う。
(4) コンポーネントレベル（GNCセンサー）からシステムレベル（SCLT, DOLT, DCLT）までを含めた軌道システム全体のハードウェアを含めた検証および妥当性確認を計画、実装、実行する。これらには、軌道上運用におけるノミナル、オフノミナルおよび故障シミュレーションが含まれる。
(5) 軌道系GNCのフライトソフトウェア／アルゴリズムの要求仕様を定義する。

title: Spacecraft Descent Guidance, Navigation, and Control System Engineer
description:
ispace is looking for Spacecraft Descent Guidance, Navigation, and Control System Engineer to join our growing team in Tokyo. 
 
You will lead the end-to-end development of the lunar lander’s landing system—including design, verification, and operations—from the perspective of the Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GNC) subsystem. 

Define requirements for the GNC subsystem, including sensors, software and other hardware components, and manage technical coordination and interface alignment with other subsystems. 

Manage the integrity and performance of GNC algorithms in the FSW development and deliverables. Support mission operations and preparation activities.
 
月着陸船の着陸系誘導航法制御サブシステムの観点から、着陸系GNCサブシステム全体開発（設計、検証、運用）を担当する。
センサー、ソフトウェアおよびその他のハードウェアコンポーネントを含む着陸系誘導航法制御サブシステムの要求定義、管理および各サブシステムとの技術調整、インターフェース調整を担当する。
各サブシステムとの技術調整、インターフェース調整を担当する。FSW開発および成果物におけるGNCアルゴリズムの完全性と性能を管理する。ミッション運用および準備活動を支援する。
 
Ideal candidate profile: 
The ideal candidate has over 5 years of experience in GNC subsystem development, including algorithm design, sensor modelling, and performance evaluation, as well as spacecraft systems engineering with failure mode analysis. The candidate is proficient in C/C++, Python, Git, and understands modern software development practices.
The candidate has hands‑on experience with closed‑loop test frameworks (MIL/SIL/PIL/HIL), developing models and interfaces for IMUs, star trackers, LiDARs, cameras, and propulsion systems, along with direct involvement in system‑level spacecraft testing (SCLT, DOLT, DCLT). Proven capability in vision‑based navigation system development is essential.
The candidate is proactive, collaborative, communicates effectively, and operates confidently in business‑level English.

Key responsibilities 
(1) Oversee the entire lunar lander landing system, supporting end-to-end development—design, verification, and operations — from the perspective of the Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GNC) subsystem.
(2) Design the Entry, Descent and Landing (EDL) GNC functions and perform GNC-related analyses (such as guidance law design and analysis, control law design and performance analysis, thruster duty analysis, DV analysis, attitude dynamics analysis, sloshing and flexible dynamics, navigation filter design, covariance analysis, various GNC sensor evaluation, etc) by using control engineering tools and in-house developed software.
(3) Plan, implement, and execute comprehensive verification and validation (V&V) activities for the landing system, spanning from component-level (GNC sensors) to system-level tests (SCLT, DOLT, DCLT).
(4) Design frameworks for the GNC FMECA (Failure Mode, Effects, and Criticality Analysis) and MCFMA (Mission Critical Fault and Mitigation Analysis) methodologies and execute fault scenarios for validating landing operations robustness.
(5) Develop a deep understanding of GNC subsystem requirements, design, constraints, and operations — including vision-based navigation — and manage technical coordination and interfaces alignment with systems engineering and other subsystems (propulsion, structures, thermal, avionics, flight software, mission planning, and operations).
(6) Define landing GNC flight software/algorithm requirement specifications
(7) Define landing GNC unit specifications as flow-down of the GNC system requirements and design specifications.
(8) Support lander system design with providing GNC feasibility studies and design inputs for the key system design trade-offs such as actuator and sensor configuration and selection, component layout, controllability, delta V, RCS budget, etc.
(9) Support the selection, verification, and operational readiness of key orbiter system components — such as IMUs, star trackers, LiDARs, cameras and propulsion — from both technical and theoretical perspectives.
(10) Design and support troubleshooting activities of GNC FSW algorithms and components and propose solutions to mitigate errors and misbehaviors in the GNC subsystem.
(11) Document the technical specifications of the GNC subsystem with a deep understanding of the functions and relations with other subsystems.

title: Backend Software Engineer (C++)
description:
Mujin is a global leader in industrial automation, redefining supply chain efficiency through MujinOS—our intelligent operating system for robotics. At our core is Machine Intelligence (MujinMI), a unique approach that leverages real-time digital twins and advanced perception, planning, and control algorithms to achieve fully autonomous operations.
Our flagship product, MujinController, empowers users with a highly configurable, no-code interface. By integrating cutting-edge motion planning and computer vision, it enables seamless automation for complex applications such as palletizing, picking, and truck unloading.
Headquartered in Japan with a growing presence in the US, China, and Europe, we invite you to join a dynamic environment where you can shape the future of automation.


We are looking for a Backend Engineer to design, build, and own the core backend systems that power our industrial robotics platforms. In this role, you will take end-to-end ownership of backend components supporting robot controllers, working close to hardware, sensors, and operating systems to deliver reliable, high-performance systems in real-world production environments. You will design and operate low-latency services, data-intensive pipelines, and robust communication paths that directly influence system behavior on the factory floor. This role requires strong systems thinking, a focus on performance and reliability, and the ability to drive improvements independently across complex, evolving systems.
 
Responsibilities
Design and own backend systems for industrial robotics platforms
Take end-to-end ownership of backend components supporting industrial robot controllers
Design, implement, and maintain reliable backend services and APIs with strong focus on performance and stability
Work on low-latency communication paths, including high-performance HTTP services and inter-process communication (e.g., ZeroMQ)
Integrate and support sensor-driven data flows
Develop and maintain backend components that interface with sensors such as 3D cameras and other industrial devices
Work with sensor SDKs, drivers, and APIs to ensure predictable data ingestion and behavior
Debug issues that span application logic, OS behavior, and device interaction
Build and operate data-intensive backend pipelines
Own and continuously improve high-performance data pipelines that influence system-wide behavior
Design database usage and data access patterns with strong awareness of scale and efficiency
Contribute to defining, validating, and improving system metrics and KPIs
Drive system reliability and operational excellence
Diagnose and resolve complex production issues across multiple system layers
Contribute to controller provisioning, reset, and upgrade workflows with a focus on stability and predictability
Improve observability, diagnostics, and operational tooling to reduce long-term operational risk
Solve complex, real-world engineering problems
Operate effectively in complex systems with evolving requirements and constraints
Make architectural and design decisions balancing performance, reliability, and maintainability
Drive improvements independently, from problem identification through implementation and rollout

Minimum Qualifications
BSc degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related fields, or equivalent academic or work experience
 Excellent experience and high proficiency in C++ and Python
 Advanced Linux user, excellent experience in Linux software development
 Expert in Linux internals, networking stack, network protocols, routing, async I/O, Docker and its internal workings
 Experience in full-stack development
 Technical communication skills in English
Preferred Qualifications
Expert in real-time OS, Linux kernel module development, EtherCAT
 Experience in robotic software development
Ideal Candidates
We are looking for individuals who are ready to take ownership of challenging problems, work proactively and independently, and collaborate closely with team members across the organization.
 You will work hands-on across the industrial robot controller stack, rather than being limited to a single component, and will tackle problems that may be new or unfamiliar, often requiring deep investigation and learning.
 Since this work has broad impact across the engineering organization, Backend System Engineers play a key role and collaborate closely with many teams.
Interview Process:
Coding Assessment: Initial technical evaluation.
 HR Interview: Discussion with Human Resources.
 Hiring Manager Interview: One or two rounds with the hiring manager.
 Take-Home Assignment & Feedback Interview (If Applicable): A task to complete on your own, followed by a feedback session.

title: Senior Space System Engineer
description:
ispace is seeking a highly motivated and talented Senior Systems Engineer to join the System Design Group under the Global Design directorate, responsible for the design and development of lunar landers and other transportation and/or communication/navigation platforms.
The ideal candidate will have in-depth experience (i.e. design, implementation, integration, V&V and operations) on at least one spacecraft subsystem, good technical knowledge of multiple spacecraft subsystems and experience in the system engineering disciplines for spacecraft design.
This is a unique opportunity to join a truly fascinating project, the first stage of ispace’s plans to perform resource prospecting on the moon. In this position, you will be assigned to one or more of ispace's projects, and join a small, international team of engineers working towards the detailed design and qualification of our first missions.
Candidates with demonstrated "hands-on" experience in some engineering domains and interdisciplinary experience are preferred. Teamwork is valued, and depending on the strengths of each member of the systems engineering team, the responsibilities listed below will be assigned accordingly.
 

Key responsibilities
· Support the definition of a “product baseline”, creating standard requirements, system architecture, ICDs, design and analysis goals, test plans and operations concepts.
 · Perform system level trade-offs, coordinating inputs from various disciplines within the team, to evaluate any proposed changes of the design baseline to satisfy the need of each individual mission.
 · Take ownership of the technical budgets, such as mass, propellant budget, power, link and data for spacecraft performance.
 · Ensure internal interfaces between various spacecraft subsystems are maintained.
 · Contribute to requirements management ensuring all requirements are closed-out at the planned project landmarks.
 · Contribute to risk assessments during the spacecraft development and support the Project Manager in defining risk mitigation plans
 · Support AIT/Flight&Test Operations Groups and subsystem leads in defining test plans and specifications which will successfully verify the spacecraft design.
 · Coordinate efforts between relevant subsystems and Operations Team in defining a spacecraft operational concept.
 · Contribute to the maintenance of our Model-Based Systems Engineering tools and the integration.
Required skills
· Bachelor or Masters degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Aerospace Engineering or equivalent
 · 3+ years of experience of systems engineering within the space industry under a Model-Based Systems Engineering paradigm.
 · 3+ years of experience in any of the following: Structure, Thermal, Avionics, GNC, Propulsion, Communications, Software
 · Experience in defining requirements for spacecraft systems
 · Experience with programming languages such as Matlab, Python, or equivalent
 · Familiarity with spacecraft design and test standards: ECSS, MIL-STD, or similar
 · Self-motivated and comfortable making key decisions within a fast-paced environment
 · High sense of accountability and ownership
 · Excellent presentation skills, both verbally and written. Enthusiastic attitude and team player
 · Business level in English
Preferred Skills 
· Requirements management and traceability of requirements until verification
 · Experience performing FMECA, reliability analysis, and/or hazard analysis
 · Experience with system level testing such as hardware-in-the-loop testing
 · Experience with spacecraft operations
 · Native/Business level Japanese

title: Spacecraft Orbiter Guidance, Navigation, and Control Software Engineer

Perform design analysis related to orbiter GNC and detailed design of GNC algorithms based on higher-level requirements. Perform algorithm implementation and testing in coordination with software engineers and GNC engineers. Participate in the testing, verification and validation phase of the GNC flight software. 月着陸船の軌道系誘導航法制御サブシステムの開発を行う。軌道系GNCに関する設計解析、上位要求に基づくGNC算術処理則の詳細設計を行う。ソフトウェアエンジニアやGNCエンジニアと協調してアルゴリズムの実装、試験を行う。GNCフライトソフトウェアの試験、検証および妥当性確認活動に参加する。フライトソフトウェア統合活動を支援し、トラブルシューティングと試験を実施するとともに、ミッション運用および準備活動を行う。

title: Space Solutions Architect
description:
ispace, inc. is looking for Solutions Architect to join our Advanced Research and Development team in Tokyo. *Space industry experience required.

職務概要
R&Dリードソリューションアーキテクトとして、あなたはコンセプト設計者としてエンジニアチームを統括し、ビジネス開発チームや顧客と直接連携しながら、シスルナ環境におけるミッション（ランダー、軌道輸送機、月周回衛星、ローバーなど）全般を対象とした提案用技術ソリューションの開発を主導します。

As the R&D Lead Solutions architect you are a conceptual designer who co-ordinates a team of engineers, partners directly with Business Development teams and Customers to lead the development of technical solutions for proposals covering the full span of cislunar environment missions (landers, orbit transfer vehicles, lunar satellites, rovers, etc.). 
It is expected that technical solution concepts start at mid/low technical maturity and you develop them to a CML2+ level (see JPL "concept maturity level" scale).
 
The position will require you to work globally, but is based in Tokyo/will require relocation and reports to the EVP of R&D (CTO Group).

国内および海外のビジネス開発チームに対するR&Dの窓口として対応し、顧客と直接コミュニケーションを取り、ニーズを把握する（輸送ミッションにおける質量要件、着陸地点／目標軌道、通信・電力・ISRUなどの運用要件など）。

title: Cybersecurity Engineer
description:
Mujin is a global leader in industrial automation, redefining supply chain efficiency through MujinOS—our intelligent operating system for robotics. At our core is Machine Intelligence (MujinMI), a unique approach that leverages real-time digital twins and advanced perception, planning, and control algorithms to achieve fully autonomous operations.
Our flagship product, MujinController, empowers users with a highly configurable, no-code interface. By integrating cutting-edge motion planning and computer vision, it enables seamless automation for complex applications such as palletizing, picking, and truck unloading.
Headquartered in Japan with a growing presence in the US, China, and Europe, we invite you to join a dynamic environment where you can shape the future of automation.


As a Cybersecurity Engineer at Mujin, you will play a pivotal role in securing the next generation of industrial robotics. You will be responsible for the end-to-end security implementation of our products, ensuring that security is not an afterthought but a core component of the development lifecycle and supporting infrastructure.
Role Overview
You will bridge the gap between technical security execution and business requirements, working across departments to harden our software and hardware assets. Your mission is to assess, implement, and continuously enhance our security posture through automation, rigorous assessment, and strategic consultation.
Key Responsibilities
Contribute to the security implementation of Mujin’s products throughout the development lifecycle and its supporting environment or assets. 
Assess, implement and enhance the security posture, configuration and technical controls of the following areas (not limited to):
General secure software/hardware development lifecycle
Secure coding guidelines and security training for developers
Threat and vulnerability management
Security integration in CI/CD Pipeline (through scripting, custom automation and deployment of various security tooling)
Infrastructure configuration (hardening, access review, asset management)
Support compliance activity across the organization by performing technical security assessments, review and technical control.
Work closely with both technical team and business stakeholders (internal or external) to identify user requirements and compliance then translate them into technical solutions.
Support cybersecurity operational activities (not limited to):
Security onboarding and awareness training
Security review and consultation
Change management process
Provide support on cybersecurity-related activities or work that is important for the company.

Requirements
Bachelor’s degree with equivalent experience required in a relevant field. 
 More than 3 years of cybersecurity operations and/or security engineer experience. 
 Sound knowledge and hands-on experience of secure product development process. 
 Knowledge and understanding of secure SDLC, application security testing and remediation. 
 Knowledge and understanding of security standards/frameworks, such as IEC 62443, CIS, etc. 
 Experience and familiarity of Git concept, containerization, Linux administration and operation 
 Excellent English written and verbal communication skills. 
 Teamwork and ability to adapt to a fast-paced working environment.
Preferred Qualifications
Master’s degree in a relevant field and/or certifications (OSCP, CompTIA, CCSP, Cloud Security) holder 
 More than 5 years of security engineering experience. 
 Sound technical expertise in cloud security controls and CSPM. 
 Familiarity with common security controls such as: 
 Key management / cryptographic concept 
 Product security design, review and testing 
 Threat modeling and risk assessment 
 Incident response management 
 Product external component, Software/Hardware Bill of Materials (SBOM/HBOM) 
 Proven record of technical implementation to meet standards, regulatory requirements and experience in obtaining industry certifications (e.g., EU CRA, NIS 2 Framework).

HR Interview: Discussion with Human Resources.
 Hiring Manager Interview: One or two rounds with the hiring manager.

title: Senior Software Engineer (C++ & Python)
description:
Mujin is a global leader in industrial automation, redefining supply chain efficiency through MujinOS—our intelligent operating system for robotics. At our core is Machine Intelligence (MujinMI), a unique approach that leverages real-time digital twins and advanced perception, planning, and control algorithms to achieve fully autonomous operations.
Our flagship product, MujinController, empowers users with a highly configurable, no-code interface. By integrating cutting-edge motion planning and computer vision, it enables seamless automation for complex applications such as palletizing, picking, and truck unloading.
Headquartered in Japan with a growing presence in the US, China, and Europe, we invite you to join a dynamic environment where you can shape the future of automation.


Team Introduction
As a Software Engineer on Mujin's Warehouse Execution System (WES) & Fleet Management (FM) team, you will play a key role in designing, developing, and deploying Mujin’s advanced warehouse execution and fleet management systems.
Our team works at the intersection of robotics, automation, and software engineering to optimize warehouse operations and ensure seamless orchestration of robots and industrial equipment.

Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain WES software to manage warehouse inventory, scheduling, and order fulfillment.
 Implement and integrate drivers for industrial hardware, including robots, conveyors, 3D cameras, sensors, PLCs, AGVs, ASRS, and WMS.
 Work with real-time operating systems (RTOS) and network protocols to ensure system efficiency and low-latency communication.
 Ensure system security by implementing robust encryption and access control mechanisms.
 Design and optimize high-performance backend services and APIs for seamless integration with third-party warehouse software.
 Develop and enhance scalable HTTP servers to handle large-scale warehouse operations.
 Collaborate closely with backend and frontend teams to improve system usability and user experience.
 Maintain code quality and testing frameworks to ensure high system reliability.
 Occasionally travel to customer sites, both domestically and internationally, for deployment and support.
 Tackle complex technical challenges in a fast-paced environment.
 Take on additional tasks related to the above responsibilities as needed.
Minimum Requirements
BSc degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related fields, or equivalent academic or work experience.
 Excellent experience and high proficiency in C++ and Python.
 Advanced Linux user, excellent experience in Linux software development.
 Expert in Linux internals, networking stack, network protocols, routing, async I/O, Docker and its internal workings
 Experience in full-stack development.
Preferable Requirements
Expert in real-time OS, Linux kernel module development, EtherCAT
 Experience in robotic software development
Attractiveness
We are looking for those who are prepared to dedicate themselves to facing big challenges, work proactively and independently, and take ownership when working with members across the teams!
 You will get your “hands dirty” working on all aspects of the industrial robot controller, not being confined to a specific component in the system. The work is challenging, mostly like something that you have never done before, requiring extensive research.
 Since the work is widely applicable, it will affect everyone in the engineering team, making the Software Engineers the likely “go-to” people. You will have chances to travel and work onsite to integrate cutting-edge industrial systems such as AGVs and ASRS.
Interview Process:
Coding Assessment: Initial technical evaluation.
 HR Interview: Discussion with Human Resources.
 Hiring Manager Interview: One or two rounds with the hiring manager.
 Take-Home Assignment & Feedback Interview: A task to complete on your own, followed by a feedback session.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Robotics OS Validation & Simulation)
description:
Mujin is a global leader in industrial automation, redefining supply chain efficiency through MujinOS—our intelligent operating system for robotics. At our core is Machine Intelligence (MujinMI), a unique approach that leverages real-time digital twins and advanced perception, planning, and control algorithms to achieve fully autonomous operations.
Our flagship product, MujinController, empowers users with a highly configurable, no-code interface. By integrating cutting-edge motion planning and computer vision, it enables seamless automation for complex applications such as palletizing, picking, and truck unloading.
Headquartered in Japan with a growing presence in the US, China, and Europe, we invite you to join a dynamic environment where you can shape the future of automation.


The Senior Software Engineer (Robotics OS Validation & Simulation) is responsible for validating the Mujin OS across our entire robotics ecosystem used in live warehouses and factories.
In this role, you will design the automated testing architecture that ensures robotic systems behave correctly when deployed in real production environments. Rather than testing isolated components, you will validate how complete systems operate together—including robot arms, custom end-effectors, vision systems, conveyors, and other industrial equipment.
Most validation is performed through large-scale simulation environments that reproduce real customer deployments. The test infrastructure runs continuously in automated environments to ensure Mujin OS continues to operate safely and reliably in production as the system evolves.
This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy working on complex, real-world systems where software, hardware, networking, and physics intersect.

Key Responsibilities
Testing Infrastructure
 Design and implement test automation frameworks that validate cross-functional behaviors of robotic systems within Mujin OS (e.g., vision-to-motion coordination, robot-to-conveyor synchronization).
 Build end-to-end test cases that simulate real customer deployments and operational workflows.
 Develop simulation components representing robots, sensors, conveyors, and warehouse systems.
 System Validation & Debugging
 Analyze test results and system telemetry to detect behavioral issues or performance regressions.
 Work with cross-functional engineering teams to isolate and resolve system-level failures.
 Technical Leadership
 Improve testing methodology and infrastructure across the engineering organization.
 Review code and mentor engineers in testing practices and quality engineering.
Minimum Requirements
BSc degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Robotics, or related fields (or equivalent academic or work experience).
 Proven experience developing production-quality software systems, not just test scripts.
 Proficiency in designing and implementing test automation frameworks and test cases for software systems.
 High proficiency in Python for developing test automation frameworks and test cases.
 Advanced Linux user with extensive experience in Linux software development.
 Business-level English communication skills.
 High motivation to deliver a high-quality robotics software platform and make a positive impact on the world.
Preferred Qualifications
Robotics Systems
 Experience with robotics frameworks (ROS, OpenRAVE, or similar).
 Experience working with robotic simulation environments.
 Software Systems
 Strong knowledge of distributed systems and inter-process communication.
 Experience with messaging systems (e.g., ZeroMQ).
 Testing & Automation
 Advanced experience with Pytest.
 Experience building large-scale automated test systems.
 Experience with E2E frameworks (e.g., Playwright).
 Others
 Familiarity with 3D programming and rendering pipelines.
 Proficiency in C++ or TypeScript.
 Business-level Japanese communication skills.
Why This Role?
You will not be running repetitive manual tests or writing simple web automation. Instead, you will design the systems that validate how multiple machines—robots, sensors, conveyors, and software—interact in a shared physical workspace. Your work will ensure that complex robotic systems configured by customers operate reliably in real production environments.

 HR Interview: Discussion with Human Resources.

title: Backend Software Engineer, Robot Platform Software
description:
About Woven by Toyota
Woven by Toyota is enabling Toyota’s once-in-a-century transformation into a mobility company. Inspired by a legacy of innovating for the benefit of others, our mission is to challenge the current state of mobility through human-centric innovation — expanding what “mobility” means and how it serves society.

Our work centers on four pillars: AD/ADAS, our autonomous driving and advanced driver assist technologies; Arene, our software development platform for software-defined vehicles; Woven City, a test course for mobility; and Cloud & AI, the digital infrastructure powering our collaborative foundation. Business-critical functions empower these teams to execute, and together, we’re working toward one bold goal: a world with zero accidents and enhanced well-being for all.

=========================================================================

TEAM
Toyota is redefining what it means to move. We're challenging the current state of mobility by enhancing the movement of people, goods, information and energy. Centered around three core concepts - A Living Laboratory™, Human-Centered, and Ever Evolving City™ - Woven City serves as a test course for mobility to fulfill our purpose of well-being for all.
 We do this by bringing together a diverse community of people with a shared passion for the future of mobility to co-create, develop and refine innovative products and services. This cross-section of social infrastructure, mobility, and people provides a unique opportunity for inventors, residents and visitors to interact seamlessly with new technologies throughout daily life in an environment that emulates a real city.
 As the Robot Platform team, we're expanding the concept of mobility beyond vehicles, building human-centric robots that work alongside people in everyday life. By co-creating an integrated robotic platform with Woven City's Weavers and Inventors, we develop robots people resonate with that grow smarter with every use, freeing people from tedious tasks and expanding human potential. Our ambition is to make Woven City a robot product factory, combining SW/HW platforms, AI, city infrastructure, and mass production.
 For more information about Woven City, please visit: https://www.woven-city.global/
WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?
We are looking for a skilled and self-motivated backend software engineer to join us in building the Robot Platform's products and services. As we deploy and operate production systems in Woven City, we are also constantly exploring new ways to bring human-centric robots into everyday life. We need a talented engineer who can help us maintain a reliable production environment while evolving our platform toward future applications. We strive to maintain a safe working environment where everyone's opinion is valued and can contribute ideas to the products and development processes.
RESPONSIBILITIES
Design, develop, maintain, and deploy high quality and reliable backend services for the Robot Platform
 Continuously improve test quality and coverage, as well as CI/CD pipelines and monitoring stack
 Collaborate with hardware, firmware, frontend, and business teams to improve overall system design and contribute to the evolution of robotic products and services
 Monitor deployed services, diagnose issues, and coordinate with the Woven City on-site operations team
 As necessary, travel to Woven City to perform on-site troubleshooting and maintenance
MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent practical experience
 5+ years of hands-on experience developing backend software, including object-oriented design, debugging, testing and use of version control systems and CI/CD
 Proficiency and hands-on experience with Java using modern tooling (E.g. Gradle, Maven, Spring Boot)
 Strong communication and collaboration skills in a multicultural and diverse workplace environment
 Strong sense of ownership and initiative, ability to learn new technologies quickly in a dynamic environment
 Business-level written and spoken English
NICE TO HAVES
Familiarity with data communication protocols like AMQP/MQTT and message brokers like RabbitMQ
 Experience developing/deploying containerized applications using Docker or Podman
 Experience with observability tools such as OpenTelemetry and Grafana
 Understanding of DevOps development methodology, including building, testing, documentation, and monitoring
 Ability to write simple frontend code using modern Javascript frameworks (e.g., React, TypeScript)
 Business-level written and spoken Japanese

title: Senior Security Engineer / Architect
description:
About SmartNews 
 SmartNews is a leading global information and news discovery company dedicated to delivering quality information to the people who need it. Thanks to our unique machine-learning technology and relationships with more than 3,000 global publisher partners, we provide news that matters to millions of users.
 Founded in 2012 in Tokyo, SmartNews also has offices in Osaka (Kansai Office), Palo Alto, New York and Singapore.
 If you share our vision and are passionate about our mission, we encourage you to apply! 
 The Security team at SmartNews protects and strengthens the company's overall security posture, working proactively rather than reactively across both our product and our corporate environment. On the Security Operations side, the team monitors systems continuously, detects and investigates threats, and manages security incidents and vulnerabilities through to resolution. On the Governance, Risk, and Compliance side, the team sets the standards and policies that guide how 
 SmartNews handles security, and ensures we meet our obligations under applicable legal and industry requirements.  Own the technical controls that make safe AI adoption possible

 セキュリティの脆弱性を防止または軽減し、システム全体のセキュリティを強化するための技術的ソリューションを開発する
 開発者およびAIエージェントのワークフローにセキュリティチェックを自然な形で組み込み、手作業のレビューに依存しない状態をつくる
 各種セキュリティツール(例:CSPM、SAST/SCA、ASM、EDR)をAPIで連携させ、各チームが自分のサービスのセキュリティ状態を自ら把握できる状態をつくる
 AIを安全に導入するための技術的なガードレールの整備を主導する
 Requirements 
 Minimum requirements 
 Proficient in English and Japanese to support a multinational engineering community
 Hands-on experience securing enterprise AI adoption at pace (third-party LLM integrations, MCP server onboarding, agentic tools acting on internal systems). We want to hear from your lived experiences and learn from them.

 多国籍のエンジニアリング組織を支援するため、英語と日本語の両方で業務を遂行できること

title: シニアコンピュータビジョン／機械学習エンジニア・Digital Twin Platform
description:
ウーブン・バイ・トヨタについて
ウーブン・バイ・トヨタは、トヨタの100年に一度のモビリティ・カンパニーへの変革に寄与していきます。「自分以外の誰かのために」発明を続けたという歴史からインスピレーションを受けた私たちのミッションーそれは、モビリティの定義を拡げ、そしてモビリティが社会に貢献する方法を拡張し、人を想うイノベーションで、モビリティの常識に挑み続けることです。

私たちは4つの柱を中心に活動しています：自動運転・先進運転支援システム技術のAD/ADAS、SDV（ソフトウェア定義車両）のための車両ソフトウェア生産プラットフォームであるArene、モビリティのテストコースであるWoven City、そして協業基盤を支えるデジタル・インフラストラクチャのCloud & AIです。また、ビジネスに不可欠な機能がこれらのチームの実装を下支えし、一丸となって「事故ゼロ社会」と「幸せの量産」の実現に向けて取り組んでいます。

=========================================================================

チームについて
トヨタはモビリティの意味を再定義します。ヒト、モノ、情報、そしてエネルギーを動かし、モビリティの常識に挑み続けます。Woven Cityでは、このような様々なモビリティを生み出し、試すテストコースとして、ヒト中心の街・実証実験の街・未完成の街をコンセプトに、幸せの量産を目指します。
 Woven Cityには未来のモビリティへの想いを共有する多様な仲間が集まります。Inventors（インベンターズ／発明家）、住民、ビジターは、ヒト・モビリティ・社会インフラが連携する街の形をしたテストコースで、生活をしながら様々なプロダクトやサービスを実証します。
私たち Digital Twin Platform チーム は、Woven City の傘下にあるコアチームの一つである Social Infrastructure/Common Platform の一員として、Woven City のビジョン「Expand mobility. Enhance humanity. Engage society」の実現を担っています。
堅牢なソフトウェアプラットフォームを開発することで、一方では発明者やビジネスオーナーが、自身のプロダクトを実際の Woven City に展開する前にバーチャル環境上で「テスト」できるようにし、他方では、住民の日常生活、交通のダイナミクス、エネルギー消費など、実際の都市から収集されるオペレーションデータとシミュレーション結果の双方に基づいて意思決定を支援する分析基盤を提供しています。
Digital Twin Platform はまだ成長初期の段階にあるため、「何をつくるか」だけでなく「どのように市場に届けるか」や「どのようなビジネスモデルを試行していくか」といった点にも大きな影響を与えながら、プラットフォームと商用戦略がともに成熟していくプロセスに関わる、貴重な機会を得られます。
 Woven Cityに関する詳細は、以下をご覧ください：
 https://www.woven-city.global/jpn/
求める人材
既存のAPIや既成のパイプラインを組み合わせるだけでなく、モデルの設計・学習・チューニングまで深く携わる、シニアレベルのコンピュータビジョン／機械学習エンジニアを求めています。
シニアエンジニアとして、技術的な方向性をリードし、高い自律性をもって行動することが求められます。単に実行するだけでなく、難しい課題へのアプローチを定義し、CV/MLスタック全体のアーキテクチャに影響を与え、チームメンバーの成長を支援する役割を担います。
物流ハブ、配送センター、工場などの実環境におけるコンピュータビジョンの課題に取り組み、作業員・車両・荷物の検出および追跡、空間利用状況の分析、作業員の行動理解を通じた生産的な作業と無駄な作業の識別などを行っていただきます。
関連分野での研究経験や博士号を持つ方を歓迎しますが、博士号は必須ではありません。博士号をお持ちでない場合でも、豊富な実務経験と同等の技術的探究心・厳密さをお持ちの方を歓迎します。
少人数で裁量の大きいチームの中核メンバーとして、技術的な判断を通じてプロダクトの方向性と実世界への影響を直接形づくっていただきます。
業務内容
産業環境向けに、物体検出、マルチオブジェクトトラッキング、分類、および行動認識のためのディープラーニングモデルを設計・学習・最適化する
 物流拠点、配送センター、工場オペレーション向けに、リアルタイムのコンピュータビジョン推論パイプラインおよび分析システムを構築・運用する
 CV/MLモデルの性能と信頼性を継続的に向上させるため、データセット戦略、アノテーション基準、モデル評価、および実験設計を主導する
 より広範なプラットフォームエコシステム内におけるCV/MLシステムの技術ロードマップ、アーキテクチャ、および統合戦略を定義・推進する
 エンジニアリングのベストプラクティスを確立し、技術的リーダーシップ、設計レビュー、および最新のCV/ML技術導入を通じてエンジニアを育成・指導する
必須条件
関連分野の学士号以上を有し、CV/MLエンジニアリングにおける7年以上の実務経験を有すること、または関連分野の博士号を有し、5年以上の応用実務経験を有すること
 モデル設計、学習、およびハイパーパラメータチューニングの実務経験があり、PyTorchまたはTensorFlowに精通していること
 最先端の物体検出・複数物体追跡システムを含む、スケーラブルなPerceptionパイプラインの開発をリードした経験。また、モデルのトレードオフ、データ品質、評価手法、実環境へのデプロイにおける制約を十分に理解していること
 本番環境において、複雑なCV/MLシステムをエンドツーエンドで提供・運用した実績があること
 技術プロジェクトを主導し、アーキテクチャ上の意思決定を推進し、エンジニアリングの方向性に影響を与えた実績があること
 古典的なコンピュータビジョン幾何学（カメラ内部・外部パラメータ、キャリブレーション、3D再構成の基礎）に関する十分な理解を有すること
 英語による優れたコミュニケーション能力（読み書き・会話）を有すること
歓迎条件
コンピュータビジョン・機械学習または関連分野のPhD

 動画アノテーションパイプラインやアクティブラーニングループの構築経験
 トップティアのCV/ML国際会議（例：CVPR、ECCV、ICCV、NeurIPS など）での論文発表実績
 Vision-Language Model（VLM）またはエージェント型システム設計の経験

title: データエンジニア・City Data Platform Development（障がい者雇用）
description:
ウーブン・バイ・トヨタについて
ウーブン・バイ・トヨタは、トヨタの100年に一度のモビリティ・カンパニーへの変革に寄与していきます。「自分以外の誰かのために」発明を続けたという歴史からインスピレーションを受けた私たちのミッションーそれは、モビリティの定義を拡げ、そしてモビリティが社会に貢献する方法を拡張し、人を想うイノベーションで、モビリティの常識に挑み続けることです。

私たちは4つの柱を中心に活動しています：自動運転・先進運転支援システム技術のAD/ADAS、SDV（ソフトウェア定義車両）のための車両ソフトウェア生産プラットフォームであるArene、モビリティのテストコースであるWoven City、そして協業基盤を支えるデジタル・インフラストラクチャのCloud & AIです。また、ビジネスに不可欠な機能がこれらのチームの実装を下支えし、一丸となって「事故ゼロ社会」と「幸せの量産」の実現に向けて取り組んでいます。

=========================================================================


チームについて
トヨタはモビリティの意味を再定義します。ヒト、モノ、情報、そしてエネルギーを動かし、モビリティの常識に挑み続けます。Woven Cityでは、このような様々なモビリティを生み出し、試すテストコースとして、ヒト中心の街・実証実験の街・未完成の街をコンセプトに、幸せの量産を目指します。
 
Woven Cityには未来のモビリティへの想いを共有する多様な仲間が集まります。Inventors（インベンターズ／発明家）、住民、ビジターは、ヒト・モビリティ・社会インフラが連携する街の形をしたテストコースで、生活をしながら様々なプロダクトやサービスを実証します。
 
トヨタ「Woven City（ウーブン・シティ）」は、富士山の麓に建設される、完全に接続されたエコシステムです。水素燃料電池によって動力を供給されるこの都市は、「リビングラボ（生きた実験室）」であり、「常に進化する」ことを目指し、さまざまな最先端技術を取り入れています。同時に、「人間中心（ヒューマンセントリック）」であり、人々の安全と快適さを追求します。
 
ウーブン・シティの研究開発（R&D）チームは、トヨタ自動車が開発した技術を活用して、革新的な製品やサービスを生み出します。
 
ミッション
1. ウーブン・シティ向けのサービスおよび製品の開発
2. 長期的な研究開発による能力拡大
 
私たちのチームは、都市にとって不可欠な革新的サービスを開発します。
一方で、ファーストパーティデベロッパーとして、サードパーティパートナーが参加できる基盤も構築します。そのため、アプリケーションだけでなく、基盤となるソフトウェアや機能も担当します。
 
Woven Cityに関する詳細は、以下をご覧ください：
https://www.woven-city.global/jpn/
 

求める人材
私たちは、ウーブン・シティの中心にある革新的なデータプラットフォームを実現することに情熱を持つエンジニアを探しています。
 このプラットフォームはイノベーターたちが利用でき、彼らのイノベーションを加速させるものです。AI、モビリティ、エネルギー管理、ヘルスケア、ライフスタイル、スマートホーム、EC、その他のウーブン・シティのサービス向けにマイクロサービス（統合APIなど）を開発します。
 このポジションでは、横断的な仕様や要件定義から開発および実装プロセス全体を推進して頂きます。
 このポジションでは同チームリーダーにレポートし、勤務形態はハイブリッド（リモートとオフィスの併用）のポジションです。
業務内容
複数のデータドメインにわたるスケーラブルなデータアーキテクチャ、データ処理、データ分析の設計・実装
 クロスファンクショナルチームとの連携
 データフロー、データストレージ、関連サービスの健全性を行うコンポーネントの構築
 ドキュメント作成やコードの保守性向上への貢献
 各チームと協力し、ベストプラクティスを開発・提供
必須条件
日本政府発行の障害者手帳を所持していること
 C++、C#、Java、Go、Rust、Pythonなど、いずれかの言語でのプロフェッショナルな経験
 SaaS、IaaS、PaaS（AWS、GCP）や同期/非同期API設計（REST、gRPC、Kafka）の経験
 Databricksのような統合分析プラットフォームを用いた複数データドメインにわたるデータアーキテクチャ設計経験
 大規模なバッチ処理またはストリーム処理のバックグラウンド
 ビジネスレベルの英語力
歓迎条件
RDBMS、DocumentDB、KVSのいずれかでの深い業務経験
 ビッグデータプラットフォーム、機械学習プラットフォーム、スタック（例：Hadoop、Spark）の使用経験
 データ及びデータガバナンスに関連する標準への理解
 データ管理に関するセキュリティプラクティスへの理解
 クラウド環境（例：AWS）におけるDevOpsやDataOpsのベストプラクティスへの精通

 Win-Winを重視する自然な協力者であり、生産的な対立を促進し、ステークホルダー（ビジネス・開発・運用）間の複雑な利害を調整して合意形成に導く能力

 ビジネスレベルの英語能力

異なる文化/言語および異なる意思決定メカニズムと論理に対応する忍耐力
 大規模なプログラム管理における専門的な経験（理想的にはデジタルトランスフォーメーション、AIの応用、IoT、スマートシティ、スマートストアなど）

=========================================================================

チームについて
Developer Toolsのミッションは、Woven by Toyotaおよびトヨタグループ全体のソフトウェアとサービスの生産性を向上させ、より早く商品をマーケットに出すことに貢献することです。そのために、エンジニアリングチームが安全なソフトウェアを迅速に開発できるよう、最新で最適な技術ツールを企画・実現しています。私たちのチームはトヨタグループ全体のエンジニアに対しアジャイルで透明性のあるサービスを提供することで、Woven by Toyotaのビジョン「Mobility to Love, Safety to Live」を実現することを目指しています。
Developer Toolsのプロダクトマネジメントチームの重要なメンバーとして、グループ・プロダクトマネージャーにレポートし、Woven内およびトヨタ全体で広く使用されている、重要なソフトウェア開発およびコラボレーションプラットフォームのプロダクトマネジメントを担当していただきます。
求める人材
技術的に複雑な商品の商品企画をリードした経験がある、プロダクトマネージャーを求めています。お客様に提供できる価値を念頭に置いて商品ビジョンや戦略を作り上げることができる方です。細部まで細かく管理できると同時に、大局的な目標を見失わず、戦略的方向性に沿った行動ができる方を求めています。ステークホルダーから最良のアイデアを引き出し、要件や優先順位を管理する能力をお持ちの方。製品のユーザーに情熱を注ぎ、全ての考え方でユーザーのことを考えて意思決定できる方を求めています。トヨタグループやWoven内の様々な部署の関係者との連携が重要です。国際的なチーム環境で関係者をまとめた経験のある方が望ましいです。
業務内容
顧客のニーズや生産性阻害要因を見つけ、ソフトウェア開発のためのコラボレーションプラットフォームのあるべき姿を考案する
 製品ビジョン、戦略、指標の作り込み
 顧客、主要ユーザー、ビジネスステークホルダーと協力し、要件や優先順位を管理する
 製品ロードマップ、実行可能な要件、およびユーザーストーリーを作成・継続的に改善する
 利用状況の分析、フィードバックループの維持、詳細なインサイトの収集を継続的に行い、顧客とユーザーへの深い理解を得る
 顧客理解を活用し、ビジネスと顧客の両方の視点から成果を定義・測定する
 社内で顧客の声を代弁し、ソフトウェア開発のためのコラボレーションプラットフォーム改善への理解を促進する
必須条件
プロダクトマネジメントの経験が5年以上
 アジャイルソフトウェア開発、クラウドネイティブ開発、エンジニアリングプラクティスの経験
 ソフトウェアエンジニアリングの技術的な経験、またはプラットフォーム製品のプロダクトマネジメント経験
 企業環境におけるB2B（企業向け）またはB2E（従業員向け）製品のプロダクトマネジメント/開発経験
 異なるビジネス文化での協業経験、特に日本の顧客とのやり取りの経験
 ビジネスレベルの英語
歓迎条件
車両ソフトウェア開発ツール、ワークフロー、及びベストプラクティスの理解
 モデルの作成からデプロイまでの全段階を含む、AIシステムに関する実務経験
 ユーザー中心設計およびユーザーエクスペリエンス（UX）に関する経験・知識
 日本語の読み書き・会話能力
 優れたコミュニケーション能力、影響力、ファシリテーション能力、およびプレゼンテーション能力

私たちは4つの柱を中心に活動しています：自動運転・先進運転支援システム技術のAD/ADAS、SDV（ソフトウェア定義車両）のための車両ソフトウェア生産プラットフォームであるArene、モビリティのテストコースであるWoven City、そして協業基盤を支えるデジタル・インフラストラクチャのCloud & AIです。また、ビジネスに不可欠な機能がこれらのチームの実装を下支えし、一丸となって「事故ゼロ社会」と「幸せの量産」の実現に向けて取り組んでいます。

=========================================================================

チームについて
トヨタはモビリティの意味を再定義します。ヒト、モノ、情報、そしてエネルギーを動かし、モビリティの常識に挑み続けます。Woven Cityでは、このような様々なモビリティを生み出し、試すテストコースとして、ヒト中心の街・実証実験の街・未完成の街をコンセプトに、幸せの量産を目指します。
 ロボットプラットフォームチームは、モビリティの概念を車両の枠を超えて拡張し、日常生活の中で人々と共に働く、人間中心のロボットを開発しています。Woven CityのWeaversおよびInventorsと共創しながら統合的なロボットプラットフォームを構築し、使うたびに賢くなり、人々の共感を得られるロボットを開発しています。私たちのロボットは、煩わしい作業から人々を解放し、人間の可能性を広げることを目指しています。SW/HWプラットフォーム、AI、都市インフラ、そして量産を組み合わせ、Woven Cityをロボットプロダクトの拠点とすることが私たちの目標です。
 Woven Cityには未来のモビリティへの想いを共有する多様な仲間が集まります。Inventors（インベンターズ／発明家）、住民、ビジターは、ヒト・モビリティ・社会インフラが連携する街の形をしたテストコースで、生活をしながら様々なプロダクトやサービスを実証します。
 Woven Cityの詳細はこちらをご覧ください： https://www.woven-city.global/
求める人材
私たちは、ロボットプラットフォームのプロダクトおよびサービスの構築を共に推進する、優秀で主体性を備えたバックエンドソフトウェアエンジニアを募集しています。Woven Cityにおいて本番システムのデプロイと運用を行いながら、人間中心のロボットを日常生活に取り入れる新たな方法を常に探求しています。信頼性の高い本番環境を維持しつつ、将来の応用に向けてプラットフォームを進化させていく、優秀なエンジニアを必要としています。私たちは、すべてのメンバーの意見が尊重され、プロダクトや開発プロセスにアイデアを貢献できる、安心して働ける環境づくりを大切にしています。
業務内容
ロボットプラットフォーム向けの高品質で信頼性の高いバックエンドサービスの設計・開発・保守・デプロイを担当する
 テストの品質およびカバレッジ、ならびにCI/CDパイプラインとモニタリング基盤の継続的な改善を行う
 ハードウェア、ファームウェア、フロントエンド、およびビジネスチームと連携し、システム設計全体の改善およロボットプロダクト・サービスの進化に貢献する
 デプロイ済みサービスの監視、障害の診断、およびWoven City現地オペレーションチームとの連携・調整を行う
 必要に応じて、現地でのトラブルシューティングおよびメンテナンスのためWoven Cityへ出張する
必須条件
コンピュータサイエンスの学士号、または同等の実務経験
 バックエンドソフトウェア開発における5年以上の実務経験（オブジェクト指向設計、デバッグ、テスト、バージョン管理システムおよびCI/CDの活用を含む）
 Javaおよびモダンなツール（Gradle、Maven、Spring Bootなど）を用いた実務経験と高い技術力
 多文化・多様性のある職場環境における高いコミュニケーション能力および協働スキル
 強いオーナーシップと主体性を持ち、ダイナミックな環境において新しい技術を素早く習得できる能力
 ビジネスレベルの英語力（読み書き・会話）
歓迎条件
AMQP／MQTTなどのデータ通信プロトコル、およびRabbitMQなどのメッセージブローカーに関する知識
 DockerまたはPodmanを使用したコンテナ化アプリケーションの開発・デプロイ経験
 OpenTelemetryやGrafanaなどのオブザーバビリティツールの使用経験
 ビルド、テスト、ドキュメント作成、モニタリングを含むDevOps開発手法への理解
 React、TypeScriptなどのモダンなJavaScriptフレームワークを用いたシンプルなフロントエ
 ドコードの作成能力
 ビジネスレベルの日本語力（読み書き・会話）

title: リサーチエンジニア - Spatial Intelligence・Vision AI Platform
description:

=========================================================================

チームについて
トヨタはモビリティの意味を再定義します。ヒト、モノ、情報、そしてエネルギーを動かし、モビリティの常識に挑み続けます。Woven Cityでは、このような様々なモビリティを生み出し、試すテストコースとして、ヒト中心の街・実証実験の街・未完成の街をコンセプトに、幸せの量産を目指します。
 Woven Cityには未来のモビリティへの想いを共有する多様な仲間が集まります。Inventors（インベンターズ／発明家）、住民、ビジターは、ヒト・モビリティ・社会インフラが連携する街の形をしたテストコースで、生活をしながら様々なプロダクトやサービスを実証します。
 Woven City Management の Vision AI チームは、コンピュータビジョンや人工知能に関連する技術を使って、ウーブン・シティを強化し活用する革新的な製品とサービスを開発しています。
 私たちの使命：
ウーブン・シティのためのサービスと製品を開発する
長期的な研究開発を通じて、技術的競争力と可能性を広げる
 トヨタ自動車株式会社は、人工知能、ロボティクス、エネルギー技術、そして自動車技術など、さまざまな技術開発に携わってきました。トヨタはすでにハードウェアにおいて特に強みを持っており、その上に新しいソフトウェアを開発することで追加の価値を創造します。
 我々はファーストパーティーデベロッパーとして、シティに不可欠な革新的サービスを開発するだけでなく、サードパーティーパートナーが参加できる基盤も構築します。私たちはアプリケーションを開発するだけでなく、よりコアとなる基本的なソフトウェアと能力も開発しています。
 私たちのチームは、多くの中途採用メンバーや国際的な職務経験を持つメンバーで構成されています。新しい文化を育むために、オープンマインドを心がけています。トヨタ自動車株式会社、北米のトヨタ・リサーチ・インスティテュート、トヨタ・モーター・ヨーロッパと密接に協力して、技術と製品を開発しています。チームには日本国外出身のメンバーも多く、グローバルな労働環境を提供しています。
 Woven Cityに関する詳細は、以下をご覧ください：
 https://www.woven-city.global/jpn/
求める人材
私たちは、空間知能を軸とした次世代AI技術の研究開発を進めています。その実現に向けて、コンピュータビジョンに関する専門性に加え、ソフトウェアとハードウェアの両面にわたる幅広いエンジニアリングスキルを持ち、高い自律性と主体性をもって研究開発に取り組めるリサーチエンジニアを募集しています。東京を拠点とするチームの一員として、研究から実装まで幅広く携わっていただきます。
本ポジションでは、物理環境の3Dシーン理解、現実世界と仮想世界をつなぐ新しいインターフェース、人の行動に働きかけながらヒューマン・コンピュータ・インタラクションを発展させるAIエージェント、人と環境を包括的に理解するための技術やパイプラインなど、将来のPhysical AIにつながる幅広い技術の研究開発に携わっていただきます。目指しているのは、AIが現実世界を認識・理解し、人・モノ・環境を豊かなデジタル表現として捉え、その理解をもとに推論や意思決定を行い、現実世界とインタラクションできるシステムです。プロダクトやアプリケーションを見据えた技術開発に加え、中長期的な研究にも積極的に取り組んでおり、論文発表をはじめとする研究コミュニティへの貢献も推奨しています。
業務内容
コンピュータビジョンを中心とした新しいアルゴリズムや技術を研究・開発し、迅速なプロトタイピングを通じて、研究成果や要素技術をプロダクトや事業につなげます。また、得られた研究成果を社内外で発表・発信します
 空間知能やヒューマン・コンピュータ・インタラクションを発展させるシステムを設計・試作・開発します。研究アイデアやプロトタイプを、実運用に必要な堅牢性・拡張性・保守性を備えたシステムへと発展させるため、研究者やバックエンド／フロントエンドエンジニアと密接に連携します
 Web、モバイルデバイス、ロボット、スマートグラス、都市インフラなど、多様なプラットフォームや実世界の環境を横断・融合する新しいインターフェースを探索・開発します
 世界トップレベルの研究者と連携し、新しいアイデアの実験・検証に取り組むとともに、その成果を論文として発表します
必須条件
コンピュータサイエンス、統計学、電気工学、その他関連分野の修士号、またはそれに相当する実務経験
 Pythonを用いたプログラミング経験、およびPyTorch、TensorFlowなどの主要な深層学習フレームワークを用いた開発経験
 機械学習、深層学習、コンピュータビジョンに関する研究経験、およびCVPR、ECCV、ICCV、NeurIPS、ICML、ICLR、ICRAなどの主要な国際会議または論文誌での論文発表実績
 英語での高いコミュニケーション能力（口頭・文書）
歓迎条件
関連する技術分野の博士号
 3Dコンピュータビジョン（シーン再構成、空間推論など）、生成AI、エージェント型AIなどの領域における研究またはアルゴリズム開発の経験
 マルチモーダル大規模言語モデルを含むマルチモーダル基盤モデルの開発経験、または生成AIを活用したプロダクト・サービスの開発経験
 新しい機能、モデル、アルゴリズム、エンドツーエンドシステムに対して、適切な評価指標やベンチマークを定義し、評価・検証した経験

title: Corporate IT Engineer（CMS Platform / IT Infrastructure）- Mercari
description:
This job requires Japanese language ability. JD is available in Japanese only. 　
Corporate IT Engineer（CMS Platform / IT Infrastructure）- Mercari
 雇用形態：　 正社員
 働き方： フレックスタイム制（コアタイムなし・フレキシブルタイムなし）　
 勤務地： 六本木
 詳細はキャリアサイトの 募集要項 よりご確認ください
メルカリグループについて
 あらゆる価値を循環させ、あらゆる人の可能性を広げる
 「地球資源が限られているなか、より豊かな社会をつくるために何ができるか」。2013年、創業者の山田進太郎が世界一周の旅で抱いた課題意識から、フリマアプリ「メルカリ」は生まれました。私たちは、物理的なモノやお金に限らずあらゆる価値を循環させることで、誰もがやりたいことを実現し、人や社会に貢献するための選択肢を増やすことができると信じています。
 テクノロジーの力で世界中の人々をつなぎ、あらゆる人の可能性が発揮される世界を実現していきます。メルカリグループの目指すべき方針については Mercari Culture Doc をご覧ください。
組織・チームのミッション 
 Mercari Engineering Principles
Mercari Engineering Principles は、メルカリのエンジニアリング組織における信念や行動の基盤となる共通認識を明文化したもので、メルカリのメンバー全員が共有するMission、Value、Cultureをエンジニアリングの視点から補完するものとなります。これらのPrinciplesは、私たちが長期的に実現しようとする理想的な姿を定義することで、最終的にメルカリのミッションを達成するために活用していきます。
 Passion For The Product
 Grow Together
 Solve Through Mechanisms
 Collaborate Openly
 詳細については エンジニアリングカルチャー をご覧ください
＜IT Division / Corporate ITのミッション＞
 IT Platform Teamが所属するIT Divisionは、「すべての時間を価値に変える 〜Zero Noise, Full Value.〜」をビジョンに、「技術力と実現力でメルカリの可能性を広げる。」をミッションに掲げています。すべての従業員がノンクリエイティブワークという「Noise」から解放され、より価値の高い創造的な業務に集中できる社内IT環境の実現を目指しています。
 その中でCorporate ITは、メルカリグループ全従業員のITノイズをゼロにする最前線のチームです。これまでは日々の大量の依頼への対応に多くの時間を使ってきましたが、ITSMの整備やAI活用が進んだことで、今は依頼に追われる状態を抜け、IT Proとして本来やるべきことに取り組めるフェーズに入っています。言われたことをそのままやるのではなく、利用者のニーズを起点に最適な手段を自ら提案し、周りを巻き込んで実現していくチームを目指しています。
 Corporate ITは、それぞれ専門性を持つ次の3チームが連携して動いています。
 Planning & Program Management：全社のニーズやIT外の組織の動向を把握し、IT全体の戦略・優先度の設定と大型施策を推進
 IT Service Management：日々の運用を通じて現場の課題・ニーズを最も高い解像度で把握し、ITサービスを運用
 IT Platform：基盤の観点から各チームと連携してソリューションを共創し、IaC化・AIOps化を推進
＜IT Platform Teamのミッションと本ポジションの役割＞
IT Platform Teamは、メルカリグループのIT基盤（サーバー / エンドポイント / オフィスファシリティ / ネットワーク）を安定維持し、継続的に改善することで、全従業員・事業・組織、そしてお客さまの可能性を広げることをミッションにしています。
業務内容
 IT Platform Teamのエンジニアとして、メルカリのコーポレートサイトを支えるCMS Platformの主担当を担っていただきます。
 CMS Platformは、IT Platform Teamが新たに持つことになった領域です。これまで外部に大きく依存していたコーポレートサイトの運用を、CMS、デプロイ、更新・公開のワークフローを含めて社内で回せる形にするため、チームで整備を進めています。社内のエンジニアとしてCMS Platformの構築・運用・改善を担い、安全に更新・公開し続けられる状態を保っていただきます。将来的には、IT Platform Teamの他のテーマにも、できるところから担当を広げていただくことを想定しています。
 具体的な業務内容は下記の通りです。
 CMS Platform（メインの担当） 
 CMSの構築・運用と、リポジトリ・CI/CD・デプロイの仕組みの構築・運用
 更新・公開のワークフローの運用と改善（Creativeチームなどと連携）
 改ざん検知、アクセス制御、WAF、脆弱性対応などのWebセキュリティ対策の実装・運用（Securityチームと連携）
 監視・アラートの整備と、インシデント発生時の一次対応・再発防止
 ホスティング環境の運用・保守
 運用手順のドキュメント化
 IT Platform Teamの他のテーマ 
 Terraformを使った基盤のIaC化と、ネットワーク運用の自動化
 構成情報の可視化と、AIを活用したモニタリング・運用の自動化
 端末・アカウント・アクセスを守るセキュリティ基盤の構築・運用
 新しい拠点・オフィスのITインフラ構築
 ※サイトのデザイン、コンテンツ制作、ページの実装は、Creativeチームと外部制作会社が担当します。
運用環境
 CMS / ホスティング / 監視：現在、構成の検討を進めています
 構成管理：GitHub, Terraform
 CI/CD：GitHub Actions
 その他：Notion, Slack, 1Password, Google Workspace
ユニークなチャレンジ
 Corporate ITは、日々の依頼対応に追われるフェーズを抜け、IT Proとして本来やるべきことに取り組める段階に入りました。「依頼をこなす」から「提案して実現する」へとチームが変わっていくタイミングで、基盤のあり方そのものを見直すところから関わることができます。
 コーポレートサイトは、候補者・お客さま・株主などが最初にメルカリと出会う場所です。その更新・公開を支えるCMS Platformを、社内のエンジニアとして担います。外部に依存していた運用を社内に取り戻していく、変化の途中にある領域です。
 Webやクラウドのエンジニアが、ネットワーク、端末、アカウント管理、オフィスまで含めた企業IT基盤全体に関わる機会は多くありません。まずは得意なWeb領域で成果を出し、その後はIT Platform Teamの一員として担当範囲を広げていけます。
 IaC化で基盤をコードで管理し、自動化からAIOpsへ。IT Divisionが目指すAI-Nativeな運用への変化を、基盤側から支えるポジションです。
 メルカリグループは、日本だけでなくアメリカでの事業展開やインドでの開発拠点設置など、グローバルに挑戦している企業です。ビジネスの特性や地域ごとの違いを考慮しながら、グループ全体にインパクトを与える基盤づくりに関わることができます。
応募要件
 求める経験・スキル
 メルカリグループおよび各カンパニーのミッションとバリューに共感していただける方
 CMS、Headless CMS、静的サイトジェネレータなどを使ったWebサイトの構築・運用経験（2〜3年以上）
 Git / GitHubを使ったソースコード管理と、CI/CD（GitHub Actionsなど）の構築・運用経験
 クラウド環境（AWS / GCP / Cloudflare / Vercelなど）での運用経験
 Webセキュリティの基礎知識（WAF、アクセス制御、脆弱性対応など）
 エンジニア以外の関係者と協力しながら業務を進めた経験
